fields.label: Dimension Key
fields.description: Name the model uses, e.g. item, customer, payment_mode

fields.label: Field Path
fields.description: Field on the source DocType, `child_table.field` (e.g. items.item_code) or `link_field.field` (e.g. customer.customer_group)

fields.label: Value Field (child)
fields.description: For child-table dimensions: the child field to aggregate instead of the metric value field, e.g. base_net_amount

fields.label: Resolver
fields.description: Registered resolver name for complex dimensions (see ai_agent/metrics/resolvers.py)
